grok.performance_metric: no divestiture; 25% interest retained; $105M related-party fees (2021)
grok.rationale: The slice documents continued productive alignment at the operating interface: the registrant kept earning commissions under fee-for-service agreements to sell timeshare interests at Elara, generating $105 million in 2021 with outstanding related receivables and no impairment or restructuring disclosed. Equity-method carrying value rose to $59 million, a ~$2 million cash distribution was received, and equity in earnings remained positive, with zero documented fracture between operations and organization or product-process incoherence through the FY2021 window.
